axes: Godot: tile centre at the node origin, x east (+X), north = -Z. Place tile (col, row) at (col * 4 + 2, 0, row * 4 + 2) with row 0 in the north; never rotate or mirror a tile: every rotation is its own file.
floor_height: Forest floor at y = 0 on every tile edge (gentle bumps inside a tile), paths 0.08 m lower, border bank 0.5 m higher.
socket_rule: Two tiles may touch when the touching edges have the same label: my east == neighbour's west, my north == neighbour's south.

socket_labels.FF: forest floor along the whole edge
socket_labels.FFP: forest floor with a 2 m path in the middle of the edge
socket_labels.BB: border (bank with bushes) along the whole edge
socket_labels.BBP: border with a path through it (the way into or out of the level)
socket_labels.FB: floor at the west/south end of the edge, border at the east/north end
socket_labels.BF: border at the west/south end of the edge, floor at the east/north end

socket_reading: Labels are read west -> east on north and south edges, south -> north on east and west edges, so a mixed edge (FB / BF) matches the same label on the neighbour.
map_edge: Use "BB" for cells outside the map to close the level with border; to make a way out, give that outside edge "BBP" (only border_exit and border_path tiles have it).
scatter_mask: 16 x 16 cells of 0.25 m per tile, rows north -> south (Godot -Z -> +Z), columns west -> east: 0 = keep clear (path and 0.6 m beside it), 1 = forest floor, 2 = border bank (dense).
